name: How long does kitchen countertop replacement take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does kitchen countertop replacement take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The actual installation of new countertops typically takes one to two days once the material is fabricated. However, the overall project timeline spans two to four weeks. During the first phase, your existing layout is measured or templated, and materials are ordered. The on-site work requires disconnecting plumbing, removing old surfaces, setting the new slabs, and reconnecting the sink and faucet. If you are also scheduling a new tile backsplash or drywall touch-ups, plan for additional finishing time right after the counters are secured.
acceptedAnswer.description: Slab installation takes one to two days, but total project duration runs two to four weeks to allow for templating, fabrication, plumbing rough-ins, and finish work.
